scope: Replay voice runtime and codec framing boundary

applied.name: ReplayVoiceRuntime_InitializeCodecAndStreams
applied.evidence: Starts the voice backend, retrieves codec framing globals used by ReplayVoice_ComputePacketSpanMs, opens the two replay voice stream directions, and records whether voice runtime initialization succeeded.

applied.name: ReplayVoiceCodec_GetFramingParameters
applied.evidence: Returns the active voice codec sample/frame and encoded-size parameters and derives the third framing value from the live codec globals.
